summary:
You asked to add the Settled Tee to the cart three times, proceed through checkout, and place the order.
The Settled Tee was added to the cart exactly three times, then the cart was opened.
The cart showed a quantity of 3 and a total of $54.00.
Checkout listed 3 × Settled Tee with an order total of $54.00.
The order was placed successfully, and the confirmation showed a charge of $54.00.
